conclusion: A clean HIP 7.15 one-queue 128K warmup completed at 503.876 prefill / 27.970 decode tok/s, then measured prefill 1 entered the persistent low-power no-progress state. The chunk-granularity GPU marker proves all work through chunk [24576,28672) retired. Host checkpoints progressed into chunk [28672,32768) through the layer-11 full-attention entry, then stopped for the remaining 1,436 seconds of telemetry. Because this source records a layer checkpoint before its synchronous for_chunk metadata copies and before the layer launch, the exact unresolved window is after layer 10 was enqueued and before layer 11 returned: layer-10 linear-attention retirement, layer-11 metadata preparation, or layer-11 full-attention/MoE work. This is a materially narrower boundary but does not establish a nonterminating kernel or exclude a KFD/MES queue/fence failure.
